inclusion_rule: Silent-speech studies (any task) whose ledger or full text names wearable accelerometers, gyroscopes or IMUs on the face, jaw or neck; the design compared is the inertial quantity used (acceleration only, gyroscope or attitude angles) and whether sensor count, subsets or axes are compared. Boundary: body-conduction microphones and accelerometers used only as vibration pickups for voiced speech, EMA/magnetic tracking without inertial sensors, and hand or body gesture IMUs are outside when read; versions count once.

read_fulltext.quote: Accuracy improved as the number of sensors increased, reaching a plateau with five sensors.
Both the accelerometers and gyroscopes of the three IMUs are used; therefore, three-axis accelerations and three-axis angular velocities are reported for each.
gyroscope data (92.39–93.39%) consistently outperformed accelerometer data (87.62–92.42%)
